name: What are the benefits of repairing drafty windows?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of repairing drafty windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repairing drafty windows offers several key benefits. Primarily, it significantly improves energy efficiency by preventing heat loss in winter and heat gain in summer, leading to lower utility bills. It also enhances indoor comfort by eliminating cold spots and maintaining a more consistent temperature throughout your home. Furthermore, reducing drafts can decrease outside noise, improve indoor air quality by preventing dust and allergens from entering, and extend the lifespan of your windows by addressing wear and tear.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits include improved energy efficiency, lower utility bills, increased indoor comfort, and reduced outside noise.
